content: Iyyu Tiyetetha
Nabey Elsi nabeta cugaape issi asi xeegidi, “Ne ma7uwa ma7ada, xaaro zaytiya ne kushen oykada, Galadan de7iya Raamota ba.
Yaa gakada, Iyosaafexa na7aa, Namisa na7aa na7aa Iyyu koya. Iya demmada, iya laggetape iya shaakada qol7a gelsa.
Hessafe guye, xaaro zaytiya ekada, iya huuphiyan tigada, ‘Nena Isra7eele bolla kawo ootha tiyana mela Goday tana kiittis’ yaaga. Yaatada pengiya dooyada, ellesada baqata” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, pantha nabey Galadan de7iya Raamota bis.
I yaa gakida wode toora moconay issife zoretishin demmidi, “Godaw, taani new odiyabay de7ees” yaagis. Iyyuy, “Nu giddofe ooddes odanee?” yaagidi oychis. Nabey, “Godaw, new odana” yaagidi zaaris.
Iyyuy dendidi soo gelin, nabey iya huuphen zayte tigidi, “Goday Isra7eele Xoossay, nena haysada yaagees, ‘Neeni Godaa deriya, Isra7eele bolla kawotana mela taani nena tiyas.
Neeni ne godaa Akaaba kochaa dhaysana. Taani Elzabeela gussida nabeta, ta aylleta suuthaanne ta hara aylleta suuthaa haluwa kessana.
Akaaba kocha ubbay dhayana; taani Isra7eelen Akaaba kochaafe aylle gidin, womaanno gidin, adde ubbaa dhaysana.
Akaaba kochaa Nabaaxa na7aa Iyorbaama kochaadanne Akiya na7aa Ba7oosa kochaada oothana.
Elzabeelo, Izra7eela goshshan kanati maana; oonika iyo moogenna’ ” yaagis. Hessa odidaape guye, pengiya dooyidi baqatis.
Iyyuy ba lagge gidida toora moconatako bida wode, enti, “Sa7i saro? Ha gooshshay neeko ayis yidee?” yaagidi oychis. Iyyuy, “Ha addiyabanne iya odaa hinte ereeta” yaagis.
Enti, “Haysi wordo. Ane neeni nuus oda” yaagidosona. Iyyuy, “Neeni Isra7eele bolla kawo gidana mela taani nena tiyanaada Goday tana kiittis” yaagis.
He wode enti banta ma7uwa qaaridi, Iyyuy yedhidi keyiya dethan hiixidi, moyze punnidosona. Banta qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Iyyuy kawotis” yaagidosona.
Kawa Iyoraama Hayquwa
Iyosaafexa na7ay, Namisa na7aa na7ay Iyyuy, Iyoraama bolla maqetis. Hessi haniya wode, Isra7eele asa ubbay Araame kawa Azaheela Galadan de7iya Ramootan naaganaw bidosona.

Shin entafe kawoy Iyoraami Soore kawa Azaheelara oletida wode, Araame biitta asay iya caddida cachas Izra7eele yis. Iyyuy halaqata, “Hinte qofay hessa gidiko, ha katamaape issi asika keyidi, Izra7eele kataman ha odaa odonnaada teqite” yaagis.
Hessafe guye, Iyyuy para gaariyan keyidi, Izra7eele bis. Iyoraami paxiboonnaysi yan shempees. Qassi Yihuda kawoy Akaziyaasi iya oychanaw yaa duge bis.
Izra7eela gimbiya bolla eqidi wocheysa xeegidi, “Issi cuga yeysa taw bentees” yaagis. Iyoraami, “Entara gahetanaada issi para yedda. Paraaway bidi, ‘Sa7i saro?’ yaago” yaagis.

Paraaway Iyyura gahetanaw bidi, “Kawoy nena, ‘Sa7ay saro?’ yaagees” yaagis. Iyyuy, “Saroban nena gathiyabay baawa. Ta guye aadhada tana kaalla” yaagidi zaaris. Wocheysi kawa, “Kiitetidaysi entako, gakis; shin guye simmibeenna” yaagidi odis.
Hessa gisho, kawoy nam7antho paraawa entako kiittis. I entako yidi, “Kawoy hintena, ‘Sa7i saro?’ yaagees” yaagis. Iyyuy, “New sarora ay gahetethi de7ii? Ta guye aadhada tana kaalla” yaagis.
Wocheysi, “Nam7antho paraaway entako gakis; shin guye simmidi yibeenna. Qassi gaariya laagoy Namisa na7aa na7aa Iyyu laaguwa mela; I gooya asada laaggees” yaagidi odis.

Kawoy Iyoraami, “Taw para gaare giigisite” yaagidi kiittis. Enti para gaare giigisidosona; Isra7eele kawoy Iyoraami Yihuda kawoy Akaziyaasi banta gaariyan gaariyan uttidi, Iyyura gahetanaw bidi, Izra7eele Naabute gaden iya demmidosona.
Iyoraami Iyyu be7ida wode, “Iyyu, sa7i saro?” yaagidi oychis. Iyyuy, “Ne aaye Elzabeeli laymatethaynne bitay de7ishin, saroy awun de7ii?” yaagidi zaaris.
Iyoraami ba para gaariya guye zaaridi baqatidi, Akaziyaasa xeegidi, “Akaziyaasa, haysi makalla” yaagis.
Iyyuy, ba dongiya ba kumetha wolqan dafidi, Iyoraama nam7u katisotape giddon dukis. Donge tooray iya wozanaara kanthidi keyin, ba gaariya giddon kundis.
Iyyuy toora mocona Bidiqaarako, “Iyoraama denthada, Naabute gaden ola. Neera taara issife Iyoraama aawa Akaaba kallidi toggidi bishin, Goday iya bolla tinbite odidaysi akeeka.

He wode Goday, ‘Naabute suuthaanne iya adde nayta suuthaa taani zine be7as; hessa acuwa taani nena tuma ha gaden qanxisana’ yaagis. Ha77i simmidi Goday gidaysada, Iyoraama denthada, ha gaden hola” yaagis.

Yihuda Kawoy Akaziyaasi hessa be7ida wode, Beet-Hagana baqatis. Iyyuy iya kaallidi yedethidi, “Iyaka wodhite” yaagis. Enti iya kaallidi, Yiblaama matan de7iya Guura pudethan iya gaariya bolla caddidosona. I Magido baqatidi, yan hayqis.
Iya aylleti gaariyan iya ekidi, Yerusalaame efidosona; iya mayzata matan Dawita Kataman moogidosona.
Akaaba na7ay Iyoraami kawotida tammanne issintho laythan Akaziyaasi Yihudan kawotis.
Elzabeeli Hayquwa
Hessafe guye, Iyyuy Izra7eela bis. Elzabeela hessa si7ida wode, ba ayfiya tiyada, ba huuphiya pixada, maskootiyara duge ogiya xeellasu.
Iyyuy pengera gelishin, “La ne godaa wodhida Zemira haysa saro yadii?” yaagasu.
Iyyuy pude maskootiyako xeellidi, “Ta bagga gidanay oonee? Oonee?” yaagis. Nam7u woyko heedzu shuufati iya xeellidosona.
Iyyuy, “Iyo duge holite” yaagis. Enti iyo duge holidosona. I suuthay godaa bollanne parata bolla dharcetis; parati banta tohuwan iyo yedhidosona.
Iyyuy kawa keethi gelidi, misinne uyis. I, “Ha baadetida maccasiw efidi moogite; ay gidikoka iya kawo na7a” yaagis.
Shin enti iyo mooganaw bidi, I guuggiyafe, tohotapenne kushetape attishin, haraba demmibookona.
Enti simmidi, iyaw odidosona; i, “Goday ba aylliya Tisiba Eeliyaasa baggara, ‘Izra7eele gaden Elzabeeli ashuwa kanati maana.
Attidaysi Izra7eelan pito mela yegetana. Hessa gisho oonika, “Hanna Elzabeelo” gaanaw danda7enna’ yaagidi odida qaalay haysa” yaagis.
